assertions: All output scores and binary payloads equal expected winners, despite scanner overwriting buffers after each yield.
Actual scanner batch count equals expected count.
Peak reservations and retained-output charges are identical across input lengths at fixed k and input order.
All query reservations release after output release.

results.large_step_time_ratio: For 16384 to 65536 rows, 4x input takes approximately 3.8x-4.2x median time across the four scenarios.

limits: Current-path scaling, not a before/after speedup comparison.
Single local run with three measured samples; timings include fixture generation and are not a CI time threshold.
No I/O, cloud latency, total heap/RSS or external scanner allocation bound is established.
Other vector shapes, wider batches and larger k remain separate validation obligations.
